hotlines.name: National Emergency Hotline
hotlines.notes: Nationwide single emergency number (police, fire, medical, disaster); operates 24/7. Sorsogon province also routes citizen emergency calls through 911.

hotlines.name: NDRRMC Operations Center
hotlines.notes: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council operations center, Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City; operates 24/7. During major disasters the NDRRMC sometimes publishes additional temporary hotline numbers via its official Facebook page.

hotlines.name: Philippine Red Cross (National Hotline)
hotlines.notes: National emergency hotline 143 and trunkline for the Philippine Red Cross; call to be routed to the Sorsogon/Bicol chapter.

hotlines.name: Philippine Coast Guard Station Sorsogon (CGS Sorsogon)
hotlines.notes: Provincial Coast Guard Station under PCG Coast Guard District Bicol; headquarters at Pier Site, Brgy. Talisay, Sorsogon City. Exercises operational control over the Sorsogon coast guard sub-stations (Matnog, Bulan, Donsol, Pilar, etc.). Listed in the official PCG Coast Guard District Bicol station directory on coastguard.gov.ph; the live page blocks automated access, so the directory was read via the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-11-12. The official Facebook page 'Coast Guard Station Sorsogon' (@cgs.sor, uses #CoastGuardPH / #DOTrPH) confirms the station but did not itself publish these numbers.

hotlines.name: PCG Coast Guard Sub-Station Talisay (CGSS Talisay)
hotlines.notes: Coast Guard Sub-Station under CGS Sorsogon; Pier Site, Brgy. Talisay, Sorsogon City (co-located with the provincial station HQ, hence the shared line). From the official PCG Coast Guard District Bicol station directory on coastguard.gov.ph, read via the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-11-12.

hotlines.name: PCG Coast Guard Sub-Station Matnog (CGSS Matnog)
hotlines.notes: Coast Guard Sub-Station under CGS Sorsogon; Pier Site, Brgy. Caloocan, Matnog, Sorsogon. Covers the Matnog ferry terminal (Sorsogon-Samar RoRo crossing), the busiest maritime gateway in the province. From the official PCG Coast Guard District Bicol station directory on coastguard.gov.ph, read via the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-11-12.

hotlines.name: Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Command Center
hotlines.notes: National 24/7 PCG Command Center at PCG National Headquarters, 139 25th Street, Port Area, Manila. Primary national escalation line for maritime emergencies and search-and-rescue, including incidents in Sorsogon waters and the Matnog ferry crossing. From the official PCG website contact page (coastguard.gov.ph), read via the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-11-07 as the live page blocks automated access. The PCG Command Center number 5278482 local 6291 is left as printed by PCG; Metro Manila numbers are 8-digit since 2019 — try (02) 8527-8482 if unreachable.
